seo.title: {{brand}} · Selected Peruvian fruit for importers
seo.description: Peruvian trading company supplying blueberries, avocados, grapes, mangoes, mandarins and ginger to international importers and distributors.

common.whatsappMessage: Hello, I'd like a quote for Peruvian fruit from Vibrance.

hero.title: Peruvian fruit, selected for the world
hero.subtitle: We choose the growers, control quality and manage the export of blueberries, avocados, grapes, mangoes, mandarins and ginger.

origen.heading: Born in a blooming desert
lines: Between the Pacific Ocean and the Andes, Peru has valleys where sun and mountain water give fruit flavour, colour and good post-harvest life.
We don't farm: we select. We work with growers on the coast and in the central jungle who meet our standards.
Every lot we offer goes through our review before it reaches you.
So an importer has a single partner for several fruits and regions of Peru.
origen.imageAlt: Green farmland in the middle of the Peruvian coastal desert
origen.mapText: We source from growers in these regions, each with the right climate for its crop.
origen.mapLabel: Map of Peru showing where the products are sourced
origen.treeLabel: Illustrated tree growing blueberries, avocados, grapes, mangoes, mandarins and ginger, which fall into a Vibrance basket.
origen.marketsText: Markets with an active phytosanitary protocol for at least one of our products.

proceso.heading: From the grower to your warehouse
proceso.intro: Five steps we control so every shipment arrives complete, on time and with its paperwork in order.

productores.title: Grower selection
productores.text: We choose growers for quality, traceability and compliance with each market's requirements.

calidad.title: Quality control
calidad.text: We check size, Brix (sweetness), ripeness and condition of every lot before approving it for export.
calidad.alt: Fruit being checked in quality control

empaque.title: Packing
empaque.text: We coordinate packing in certified packhouses, in the format and labelling each customer needs.

frio.title: Cold chain
frio.text: Fruit is pre-cooled and travels temperature-controlled to the port or airport.

envio.title: Documents and shipping
envio.text: We handle phytosanitary and origin certificates and customs paperwork, and ship by sea or air.
envio.alt: Fruit crates being loaded onto the dispatch truck

productos.heading: What we offer
productos.intro: Fresh Peruvian produce, graded by size and packed to suit each market.
